text: Drake Maye continued his confidence-building trajectory with a five-touchdown performance—accounting for scores both through the air and on the ground—as the Patriots demolished the Raiders 45-17 at Gillette Stadium on Sunday, a dominant display made all the more impressive given New England's mounting injury toll and the absence of their top receiver and both starting cornerbacks. The victory came at a cost, however, with running back TreVeyon Henderson exiting with an ankle injury and left tackle Will Campbell suffering what sources believe to be a knee sprain, adding to an already depleted roster that nonetheless showed the resilience to cruise past Las Vegas. Maye's sharp showing suggests he has found his rhythm and his deep ball after an uneven start to the season, providing genuine optimism that the young quarterback can elevate this team even when key contributors go down around him.
